summary: The farewell episode of Stephen Colbert's show was a festive yet emotional occasion, featuring highlights like playful banter about the Pope and tributes from fellow hosts Jimmy Kimmel and Jimmy Fallon, while intentionally avoiding mention of Donald Trump.

Jimmy Kimmel and Jimmy Fallon paid tribute to Colbert, highlighting their camaraderie.

narrative_structure.purpose: Discuss the intentional avoidance of political topics
narrative_structure.summary: Colbert deliberately avoided referencing Donald Trump, focusing instead on celebrating creativity.
